title: DNAgent CLI envelope 0.10.0
description: Runtime JSON responses only. CLI argument errors and GUI output are not covered. Coordinates are zero-based and half-open; relational bounds require domain validation.

isoforms.description: Isoforms of a gene locus document, ordered by panel-mean expression under `quantifier` (null when the locus has no expression data). Spans are zero-based, half-open on the locus sequence; genomic (1-based) = genomic_start + position.

missing_features.description: Transcripts whose mRNA feature was deleted from the document.

reports_zeros.description: False for sparse quantifiers: a cell line without a value counts as 0 in the panel mean.

order.description: Transcript ids, highest panel mean first; then evidence, MANE, id.

cds.description: Coding blocks including the stop codon.

component.description: 1-based component this pair amplifies; provided fragments have no pair.

preparation.description: How the fragment reaches the reaction. A provided fragment (restriction digest, synthesis, stock DNA) gets no primers.

fragment_sequence_5to3.description: The fragment as it enters the reaction: core plus primer tails when amplified, the core itself when provided.

forward_primer.description: Null for a provided fragment, which is not amplified.

reverse_primer.description: Null for a provided fragment, which is not amplified.

added_by.description: Which primer writes this overlap as a 5-prime tail; null when the fragments already overlap.
